anomalies.description: Large group of people in chaotic motion, with multiple individuals reacting to gunfire, broken glass, and aggressive postures; consistent with violent group unrest following initial shots.
A man (Tom Cruise) fires a handgun; muzzle flash is visible and glass shatters immediately after in the next frame.

A man (Simon Pegg) is seen breaking through a glass barrier (shattered glass in f2, f3), followed by physical engagement with others; in f4 he is standing aggressively near the breach, and in f5 a woman restrains another person, indicating close-quarters struggle.
A man (Tom Cruise) draws and fires a handgun at an off-screen target; muzzle flash is visible in frame f6 (39.0s), and the gun is clearly aimed and discharged between f4 and f6.
A second man (short-haired, dark jacket) fires a handgun; muzzle flash visible in frame f13, followed by shattered glass in f14 and f15.
A woman grabs the man from behind as he draws and aims his weapon, indicating physical struggle during the draw/firing sequence.
A man (Tom Cruise) is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible in frame f4 (41.5s), and the gun is held in a firing stance across frames f3–f6.
